answer:
I don't know. The retrieved documents don't give any throughput figure for `IngestionPipeline`, such as documents per second on a single CPU core. Throughput would depend on which transformations you use (splitters, extractors, embedding models) and on your hardware.

The closest thing the documents say is about parallelism:

"The `run` method of `IngestionPipeline` can be executed with parallel processes." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/loading/ingestion_pipeline/index.md]

To use it, you set `num_workers` in `pipeline.run(documents=[...], num_workers=4)`. This is a way to scale across processes, not a benchmark. To get a real number, you would need to time your own pipeline on a sample of your data.
